metaDescription: How to rent a room safely in Bulgaria: never pay before a viewing, spot common scams, check who owns the property and put everything in writing.
title: Safety tips
intro: Most people on Stay.bg are exactly who they say they are. These habits protect you from the few who are not.

points.viewFirst: Do not send a deposit, a reservation fee or the first month’s rent before you have viewed the room in person and met the owner or their representative.
points.untraceable: Refuse to pay through money transfer services, crypto, vouchers or gift cards. Those payments are almost impossible to get back.
points.receipts: Pay by bank transfer to an account in the landlord’s name, and get a signed receipt for anything you pay in cash.

points.price: The rent is far below similar rooms nearby.
points.abroad: The owner is “abroad” and will send the keys by courier once you pay.
points.pressure: You are pushed to decide today because “many other people are interested”.
points.offPlatform: You are asked to move to another app straight away, or sent a link to a “booking” site that wants your card details.
points.photos: The photos look like a hotel or show up in other listings. A reverse image search takes a minute.

points.record: Arrange the viewing through Stay.bg, so there is a record of when and where.
points.company: Go in daylight if you can, take a friend or tell someone where you are going.
points.check: Check that the room matches the photos, and test the water, heating, windows, locks and internet.
points.flatmates: If you will share the home, meet the people you will live with.

points.deed: Ask to see the title deed (нотариален акт) and compare the owner’s name with their ID card.
points.register: You can also confirm the owner with a search in the Property Register (Имотен регистър) of the Registry Agency.
points.attorney: If someone rents the place out for the owner, ask for a notarised power of attorney (пълномощно).
points.sublet: If you rent from a tenant, ask for the owner’s written consent to sublet.

points.lease: Sign a written lease that names both parties and states the rent, the deposit, what is included, the term and the notice period.
points.handover: When you move in, sign a handover protocol (приемо-предавателен протокол) recording the condition of the room, furniture and appliances, the meter readings and photos.
points.copies: Keep a copy of everything you sign and of every payment.

points.record: Messages on Stay.bg are a record if something goes wrong, and they let us act on a report.
points.personal: Do not share a copy of your ID card, your personal number (ЕГН) or bank details before you get to signing the lease.

points.report: If a listing or a person seems wrong, report it from the listing or the profile. Reports are confidential.
points.block: Block someone from their profile or a conversation to stop them messaging you or requesting viewings.

emergency.title: In an emergency
emergency.body: If you are in danger, call 112. It is free and works anywhere in Bulgaria. If a scammer has taken your money, tell your bank and the police straight away.
